scope: SBSI governance-style DOCX documents (Quy định, Quy trình, Quy chế, Hướng dẫn and equivalents), applied by sbsi-docx-format-core AFTER sbsi-template-router has resolved a document-type-specific template. This is the machine-readable mirror of FORMAT_CONVENTIONS.md — prose is authoritative for rationale, this file is authoritative for the literal values the scripts consume.

ordinary_text_typography._display_size_margin_note: Relative, not absolute: a direct (non-style-inherited) run/paragraph-mark size override strictly greater than (this template's resolved ordinary target size + this margin) is treated as deliberate display/title typography (e.g. a bold pseudo-heading), not an ordinary-text sizing mistake. Relative to the template's OWN typography_profile so it scales correctly whether the template's ordinary baseline is 13pt (governance docs, margin -> >14pt is display) or 12pt (BRD, margin -> >13pt is display) — a fixed absolute pt value would silently misclassify a template whose baseline differs from the global default.

structural_numbering.rule: Structural clauses/sub-points (Khoản, Điểm, and equivalents) must carry real w:numPr bound to word/numbering.xml. Never type '1.', 'a)', 'Điều 1.' etc. as literal paragraph text.

appendix_exception.zone_note: The appendix-tolerance zone is NOT open-ended once triggered: it runs from an appendix-marker paragraph until the next paragraph matching the chapter-boundary pattern (a new Chương/Phần), or end of document, whichever comes first. Without this bound, a mid-document appendix reference (e.g. an Điều citing 'theo Phụ lục số 01') would silently downgrade every real Khoản/Điểm numbering violation in every following chapter to a non-blocking warning.
appendix_exception.rationale: A manually-numbered reference/bibliography list inside an appendix is a tolerated SBSI drafting convention, not a structural Khoản/Điểm clause.

structural_numbering.restart_behavior: Khoản and Điểm numbering restart per the selected template's own numbering.xml abstractNum/num definitions and outline scoping — never re-implemented ad hoc.

structural_headings.rule: Chapter/Article/section titles must be real Word paragraph styles carrying a resolved outline level (direct w:outlineLvl, or inherited via the style's basedOn chain). Never bold+centered Normal text imitating heading vocabulary.
structural_headings.fake_heading_detection: text matches a heading pattern AND has no resolved outline level -> ERROR
structural_headings.outline_level_source_of_truth: Discovered per-template from styles.xml, recorded informationally in that template's template_manifest.json (known_style_hierarchy) — never assumed to be a fixed number across templates.

toc.rule: A 'Mục lục' (or Table of Contents) heading requires a real Word TOC field: an instrText run containing 'TOC' between w:fldChar begin/separate/end markers. Never typed dot-leader text.

format_only_mode.allowed_transformation: Replacing a manually-typed structural prefix with the equivalent real Word numbering/heading style; visible wording must stay semantically identical.

fail_closed_conditions: sbsi-template-router did not return status RESOLVED
render QA has not been completed and visually inspected for every page
manual/typed structural numbering remains in scope (outside the tolerated appendix exception)
ordinary-text typography does not resolve to Times New Roman 13pt
